title: Original CyberPetsAI collection
content: The project materials describe the original CyberPetsAI collection as living on Polygon. The referenced OpenSea collection is https://opensea.io/collection/cyberpetsai. Collection-level descriptions should not be used to infer a specific NFT's traits or rarity.

title: CyberPetsAI Reboot collection
content: The CyberPetsAI Reboot collection represents glitched and corrupted companions in the project's narrative. The project materials associate Reboot NFTs with Bootkeys and containment-agent role-play. Referenced collection: https://opensea.io/collection/cyberpetsai-reboot/overview.

title: CyberPetsAI Trainer Lite
content: The project materials describe CyberPetsAI Trainer Lite as an interactive NFT experience where holders can train, clean, play with, and care for a digital pet. Referenced collection: https://opensea.io/collection/cyberpetsai-trainer-lite-1.
